none: PAS CAM-D67F41: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy Contemporary Copy of a Nummus of Valentinian I
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE ; D/ DN VALENTINIANVS PF AVG

A copper-alloy contemporary copy of a nummus of Valentinian I. Showing mint as Arles, AD367-375, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE. Reverse shows Victory advancing left with wreath. See LRBC cf p.56, no.514. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads DN VALENTINIANVS PF AVG. Reverse fields and exergue read: OF/I//CON[...]. Die…
